title: Äther und Relativitätstheorie: Rede gehalten am 5. Mai 1920 an der Reichs-Universität zu Leiden
note: 15 pp. Leiden address of May 5, 1920; English translation 'Ether and the Theory of Relativity' in Sidelights on Relativity (Methuen, London, 1922, pp. 3-24). Characterises a relativistic ether stripped of any definite mechanical state of motion.
